summary: Iteration 9: User approval flow and separate admin/user login testing completed. Backend: 13/13 tests passed - registration with pending status, admin/user login separation, approval/reject flows, role mismatch blocking. Frontend: All UI tests passed - user login page matches design (title, Bireysel type, email/password fields, remember checkbox, forgot password link, orange submit, register link), admin login page with dark theme and orange accents, admin panel with orange theme and sidebar overflow-y-auto for scroll, user approvals page functional with approve/reject buttons, role-based redirects working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: MOCKED: Paper execution runtime remains in mock/paper mode - no live trading
Separate login endpoints: /auth/login/admin and /auth/login/user enforce role-based access with 403 'Yanlış giriş paneli' on mismatch
Admin panel uses admin-ops-theme CSS class; User panel uses user-theme CSS class - both result in orange theme per App.css
Sidebar has overflow-y-auto class for scroll support when menu items exceed viewport
seed_data_creation: Multiple TEST_ prefixed users created during backend testing for approval flow verification
context_for_next_testing_agent: User approval flow fully functional. Backend endpoints: POST /auth/register (creates pending user), POST /auth/login/admin, POST /auth/login/user (role-specific), GET /auth/admin/user-approval-requests?status=pending, POST /auth/admin/user-approval-requests/{id}/approve, POST /auth/admin/user-approval-requests/{id}/reject. Admin panel routes: /admin/*, User panel routes: /user/*. ProtectedRoute component handles role mismatch redirects. Both panels use orange theme via CSS classes.
